name: 04_Telegram_Notify
description: Receives real "nervous system" events via factory_loop.js's notifyGoldenHunterAccepted()/notifyFactoryRecoveryEvent() (lib/n8n_notify.js), and forwards each to Telegram as a real Arabic message via a plain HTTP Request to Telegram's Bot API (not an n8n Telegram credential -- this instance's REST API/UI was not reachable this session to create one; TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN/OPENCLAW_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID are read from the n8n process's own environment via $env, never embedded in this file). Autonomous Digital Company v1 follow-up (2026-07-19): the "Build Telegram Message" node used to hardcode ONE message template regardless of the real event field sent to it -- every other event type (factory_stopped_unexpectedly, factory_recovered, recovery_completed, retry_queue_status) silently produced a garbled golden-hunter-shaped message with undefined fields. Now branches on $json.body.event with the correct Arabic template per event, plus two newly wired events: pending_review_needed ("جاهز للمراجعة") and sale_detected ("بيع جديد"). Imported via CLI while n8n was offline (ADR-072) -- same safe pattern as ADR-045. Message text is Arabic (ADR-073, 2026-07-18): the founder reads Arabic, not English.
